messages:
maya: Quick check-in on hero options + routing for the launch pages. Need a short copy set for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, one perf-first and one economics-first variant each, plus a clear webinar CTA and inbound routing plan.

devin: Draft hero ideas (two each):
- Hosted (Perf): "Prototype fast. Sub-second responses with SDKs & streaming."
- Hosted (Econ): "Pay-as-you-go inference. Lower per-token cost with batching and KV cache."
- Dedicated (Perf): "Predictable p99s with reserved GPU pools."
- Dedicated (Econ): "Committed capacity that reduces unit cost at scale."
- Private (Perf): "Run inside your network for consistent latency and control."
- Private (Econ): "Bring your own infra: compliance-grade, cost-managed deployments."

li: Nice. For subheads keep them actionable and mobile-friendly. Examples:
- Hosted subhead: "SDKs, streaming, and one-line setup."
- Dedicated subhead: "SLA-backed capacity and burst options."
- Private subhead: "VPC, KMS, and audit trails."
Also suggest 3 micro-bullets under each hero (what to expect) e.g. Hosted bullets: SDKs, streaming, usage analytics.

sam: Legal flag: don't state exact latency numbers unless Ops confirms. Use "low-latency" / "sub-second" as fallback. We can claim batching & KV cache as features. Recommend linking to the benchmark post for any savings language.

nate: Webinar CTA suggestion: "Register: How teams serve LLMs reliably (launch webinar)". Routing plan: webinar signups -> marketing nurture (3-email series), webinar attendees who open >1 mail -> MQL -> SDR queue; demo requests -> AE immediate; benchmark downloads -> assign product-eval + auto trial token. I can produce webhook examples for each.

emily: For A/B testing, propose: test Perf vs Econ for first 7 days at 50/50, then promote winner 80/20. For creative, we need two hero images (abstract infra + human dev). Mobile-first comp is required.

webinar-bot: Upcoming webinar 2026-04-07 10:00 PDT: "Serving LLMs for production: latency, cost, and rollouts" - reg https://redwood.ai/webinar/reg

devin: CTAs: primary = "Register for webinar" or "See latency & pricing" (for Hosted). Secondary CTA = "Start free trial" or "Request a demo" (for Dedicated/Private). Keep CTAs consistent across hero variants and pass UTM params.

li: Microcopy for bullets (3 each):
Hosted: 1) Quick SDK setup, 2) Streaming + partial responses, 3) Token-level cost analytics
Dedicated: 1) Reserved GPUs + burst, 2) Autoscale rules, 3) SLAs & SRE runbooks
Private: 1) VPC & on-prem options, 2) KMS/HSM integration, 3) Audit logs & compliance

sam: Add a short line on the page linking to the benchmark blog: "See independent benchmarks and model profiles -> [benchmark post]". Legal will check link copy.

nate: Inbound routing mapping (engineer-friendly):
- webinar_reg -> tag:marketing:webinar -> nurture_flow_id:WBNR-2026 -> webhook:/events/webinar_reg
- demo_request (dedicated/private) -> assign:AE_team -> tag:sales:high_touch -> webhook:/events/demo_request
- benchmark_download -> assign:product_eval -> create:trial_token + email:product-eval@redwood.ai -> webhook:/events/bench_dl
Include UTM param mapping and a header x-source:marketing. I can drop sample payloads in #eng-infra.

maya: Action items:
- devin: finalize hero lines + desktop/mobile CTAs by 3pm PT (include UTM suggestions).
- li: export two hero comps (perf/econ) + mobile variants by 5pm PT.
- nate: publish webhook payload templates + SDR tag mapping by EOD.
- sam: confirm legal-friendly wording and benchmark link placement by EOD.
- emily: set A/B test in the growth dashboard (50/50) once copy lands.

maya: If everyone is good, I'll fold this into the launch post and the growth brief. Please react with :white_check_mark: to approve or comment inline.
